_source_note: Draft checklist based on WHO snakebite envenoming guidance and Indian NHM Standard Treatment Guidelines for Snakebite. VERIFY against your team's selected official source (WHO / NHM STG / national rabies & animal bite guidelines) before final use. Not a diagnostic tool.

animal_type.description: What kind of animal (snake, dog, scorpion, cattle/livestock, other) and, if known, how it looked

time_since_incident.description: How long ago the bite/kick/sting happened

bite_or_injury_site.description: Location on the body of the bite, sting, or injury

progressive_swelling_or_pain.description: Whether swelling or pain at the site is spreading/increasing (snakebite envenomation marker)

bleeding_abnormal.description: Unusual bleeding from the bite site, gums, or elsewhere (bleeding syndrome marker for snakebite)

neurological_signs.description: Drooping eyelids, blurred vision, difficulty speaking/swallowing, muscle weakness (neurotoxic marker)

breathing_difficulty.description: Any difficulty breathing or chest tightness

for_animal_bites_provoked_or_unprovoked.description: For dog/animal bites: was the animal a stray, was it provoked, is it known/vaccinated (rabies risk assessment)

wound_appearance.description: Puncture marks, laceration, crush injury, bruising
